title: Unit Event — The Song of a Canary in Crisis — Episode1 To Become The Canary

meta.Event: The Song of a Canary in Crisis
meta.Event Outline: As the 30th Anniversary Show approaches, Nene is hard at work preparing for her role as the Cowardly Canary. However, during a rehearsal, the director criticizes not her acting, but her singing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay, I think I have this song down.
And I'm producing high notes much better than usual...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Alright...
I'll try again from the top.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (First, the scene when I meet Rio for the first time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“U-Umm...
Thank you for praising my singing.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“I really love to sing...
I mean, it's how I communicate.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“No, it might be more than that...
Unfortunately, I'm not very good at talking to other people...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We've been practicing for the 30th Anniversary Show for a while now.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (After seeing those two perform, I felt that I also should do everything I can. That I need to do my best...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why I've been trying to do what Tsukasa did. I've been working on becoming the Cowardly Canary...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I watched the birds as they gathered on the trees in the park, and tried singing based on how I think they're feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (As a result, compared to when we first started, I've been able to immerse myself into my characters much better.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I still don't think I can put on that kind of performance.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm having a hard time seeing myself bringing my character to life the way they did....)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But that's no reason to get myself down...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're supposed to start practicing scenes that include the Cowardly Canary tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Am I really gonna be ready to put on even a half-decent performance by then...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No... Not as I currently am.
So...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'll need to start looking for some hints tomorrow during practice.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
And by the time the curtains go up...
I'll have my Cowardly Canary polished to perfection.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm gonna be as good as those two...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Alright, as I mentioned before...
Starting today, we'll be working on the scenes where Rio meets the forest's various birds as he chases after the Phoenix.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
So, from the top.
Where Rio first meets our canary.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “At this rate, I'm never going to catch up to her, let alone capture her...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“*Sigh*
If only I had wings like her...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“Huh?
There's something on top of that tree over there.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(This is it!
The scene where Rio hears the canary sing for the very first time!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I'm so excited! I can't wait to see how Nene goes!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (At this moment, I'm not aware that Rio is there...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Which is why I'm singing to my heart's content. I just need to sound like I'm enjoying myself.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! Her voice is so pretty...!
It's like she's a real bird!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, she's certainly captured a canary's singing voice nicely. Going through the trouble of breaking down her character seems to have been well worth it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
“What a beautiful voice...
I'd like to hear it more up close...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Oh, I'm sorry! I didn't mean to startle you! I was just...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Oh... I-I'm sorry...
But please... Go somewhere else...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“I don't like humans...
Because they're always mean to me...”

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Rio.
You overdid it there when the canary shooed you away.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Yes, it is important to exaggerate in order to get your message across to the audience. However, there are times when that can work against you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought Tsukasa did a really good job just now. It felt so real and yet there's still things to work on...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Which means...
How much of an earful am I gonna get?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was able to sing the first part the way I practiced it, but my acting still felt...)

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Yes, I thought you captured the Cowardly Canary's personality rather well.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line:
Just work on your breathing.
As you gain a better understanding of what it means to be “cowardly”, you should be able to speak and act in a more convincing fashion.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, that is all regarding your acting...

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As for your singing, it simply won't do at this rate.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Your character sings two songs in total during this show. The second one in particular plays a vital role in changing how Rio and the phoenix view one another.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: As your current rate, you're going to struggle to move the audience. At the moment, Kusanagi, your singing sticks out just that much.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Please research what the Cowardly Canary is supposed to sound like for this show while keeping in mind how your lines and songs are tied together.

rows.Speaker: Director
rows.Line: Now, our next scene has... The Great Eagle!
